meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会把你在 NanoClaw 里自己做的改动(配置、代码、技能等)整理成一份迁移指南。之后当上游发布新版时,它会先拿到干净的原版,再照着指南把你的改动重新加上,避免合并代码引起的冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求升级定制过的 NanoClaw 到上游新版本,或想要生成、更新迁移指南时。若已有现成指南,会提示直接进入升级阶段。

say.text: 把定制过的 NanoClaw 升级到上游最新版,保留我的所有改动
say.note: 会先检查 Git 工作区,确认安全后再动手。

say.text: 先扫描我这个项目里改过的地方,生成迁移指南
say.note: 会派出子代理分析代码,汇总清单向你确认。

say.text: 把后来新加的自定义改动也更新进迁移指南
say.note: 会对比上次生成点,把新改动追加进去。

howto.what_en: This skill turns your hand-made changes in a NanoClaw fork (config, code, skills) into a migration guide. When upstream updates, it starts from clean upstream and reapplies those customizations from the guide, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to upgrade your customized NanoClaw to the latest upstream, or to generate or update the migration guide. If a guide already exists, it can skip straight to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Upgrade my customized NanoClaw to the latest upstream, keeping my changes.
say_en.note: Runs preflight and starts the migration flow.

say_en.text: Scan my project and build a migration guide from my changes.
say_en.note: Uses sub-agents to explore code and summarize changes.

say_en.text: Update the existing migration guide with my newer changes.
say_en.note: Diffs changes since the guide was recorded and appends them.
